text:
Kathy owns the Miami condominium outright by survivorship under the tenancy by the entirety created by Bill’s signed and delivered deed. Tommy takes the Deerwoods pasture under the will, and Tommy and Julie share the remaining probate assets equally. Kathy’s valid prenuptial agreement waives her pretermitted-spouse, elective-share, and homestead rights, so she receives nothing further from the estate.
CONFIDENCE: 88
